title: Introducing Sandbox Computer Use for Mastra Agents
summary: Give your agents a computer to use, just like you do.
body_markdown:
Your Mastra agents can now control a real Linux desktop with[computer tools](https://mastra.ai/docs/sandbox/computer) . Browse the web, fill in forms, download files, take screenshots, and run programs from a terminal — all from the safety of a sandbox.


We're launching today with two providers:[E2B Desktop](https://mastra.ai/integrations/sandboxes/e2b-desktop) and[Daytona](https://mastra.ai/integrations/sandboxes/daytona) . Both expose 11` computer_*` tools your agents can use:


- **Screenshot** :` computer_screenshot`
- **Mouse** :` computer_click` ,` computer_double_click` ,` computer_right_click` ,` computer_move_mouse` ,` computer_drag` ,` computer_scroll`
- **Keyboard** :` computer_type` ,` computer_press_key`
- **Environment** :` computer_get_screen_info` ,` computer_wait`


Your browser does not support the video tag.


An alternative is to use Mastra’s[browser capabilities](https://mastra.ai/docs/browser/overview) so your agents navigate the web, extract data, and pass it back for processing. But with computer tools, you can extend an agent's capabilities by giving it access to the whole sandbox operating system.


Supported providers implement Mastra's[SandboxComputer](https://mastra.ai/reference/workspace/sandbox#computer-capability) interface, which includes several helper methods:` .getScreenSize()` ,` .getCursorPosition()` , and` .streamUrl()` — to watch your agent live at work.


## Get started


Install the E2B Desktop provider:


Terminal


```text
npm   install   @mastra/e2b-desktop
```


note


Requires` @mastra/core@1.62.0` or later, added in[PR #21700](https://github.com/mastra-ai/mastra/pull/21700) .


Attach an` E2BDesktopSandbox` to your agent's` Workspace` :


src/mastra/agents/computer-tools-agent.ts


```text
import   {   Agent   }   from   "  @mastra/core/agent  "  ;
import   {   Workspace   }   from   "  @mastra/core/workspace  "  ;
import   {   E2BDesktopSandbox   }   from   "  @mastra/e2b-desktop  "  ;


export   const   computerToolsAgent   =   new   Agent  ({
id:   "  computer-tools-agent  "  ,
name:   "  Computer Tools Agent  "  ,
instructions:   /* ... */  ,
model:   "  anthropic/claude-sonnet-5  "  ,
workspace:   new   Workspace  ({
id:   "  computer-tools-workspace  "  ,
sandbox:   new   E2BDesktopSandbox  ({
id:   "  computer-tools-desktop  "  ,
apiKey: process.env.E2B_API_KEY,
})
}),
defaultOptions: { maxSteps:   50   }
});
```


For more information and full configuration options, see:


- [Computer](https://mastra.ai/docs/sandbox/computer)
- [E2B Desktop sandbox](https://mastra.ai/integrations/sandboxes/e2b-desktop)
- [Daytona sandbox](https://mastra.ai/integrations/sandboxes/daytona)
- [Workspace sandbox reference](https://mastra.ai/reference/workspace/sandbox)
- [SandboxComputer](https://mastra.ai/reference/workspace/sandbox#computer-capability)
